demo.banner_header: Demo mode — simulated, no real AWS
demo.banner_body: This is a no-AWS demo: data is simulated client-side, nothing is deployed, and no AWS resources are created or billed.

settings.description: Toggle runtime features for this tenant. Changes take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
settings.save_error: Failed to update the feature flag.
settings.readonly_notice: Only a tenant admin can change these settings.

login.title: TenkaCloud Application Admin Console
login.subtitle: Sign in with your tenant operator account.
login.error_body: We could not start the sign-in flow.
login.saml_pick_idp: Multiple identity providers are connected for this domain. Pick one to continue.
login.stage_lede: Create events, distribute problems, and manage teams for your tenant — all from this console.
login.note_body: No password is stored. Auth is delegated to Cognito / your SAML IdP.

home.tenant_name_missing_header: Tenant name is missing from your JWT
home.tenant_name_missing_body: Sign out and sign back in. If the issue persists, ask the System Admin to check your tenant settings.
home.next_action_body: When you deploy a problem to a competitor account, participant URLs (frontend / api) and a per-team login key are issued. No per-individual accounts are created, so operators do not take on personal-data obligations. Start by picking a problem from the catalog.

event_list.description: Competition events. One event = N teams x M problems that can be deployed and torn down in bulk.
event_list.empty_no_event: No events yet. Start by clicking "Create event".
event_list.empty_all_archived: No events match. Tick the checkbox above to include ended ones.
event_list.archive_modal_body: Archiving event {name} removes it from the default view.
event_list.archive_modal_note: You cannot un-archive, but child deployment / Team rows are auto-removed by TTL. Run Bulk Teardown first if you haven't.
event_list.archive_conflict_known: Event "{name}" cannot be archived (current: {current}, allowed: DRAFT / ENDED / TEARDOWN)

problems.description: Problems deployable to competitor AWS accounts. Filter by search / category / status / difficulty / tag.
problems.search_placeholder: Search by name / description / tag (substring, case-insensitive)
problems.pack_guidance_modal_description: TenkaCloud can use both the official catalog and private Problem Packs. This is guidance only; install and activation stay in the CLI.
problems.pack_guidance_path_official_body: Use this path when the problem should become part of the shared official catalog for everyone.
problems.pack_guidance_path_private_body: Use this path for tenant-specific or unpublished problems that should appear only after the pack is installed and activated.
problems.pack_guidance_step_install: Install the immutable pack revision into the local pack store.
problems.pack_guidance_step_activate: Activate the installed revision for the target tenant.
problems.pack_guidance_step_create_event: Create an event in this console.
problems.pack_guidance_create_event_note: After activation, the pack's problems appear in the catalog while creating an event.
problems.pack_guidance_empty_hint: You can contribute problems to the official catalog or add private Problem Packs for this tenant.

problem_search.filter_description: Use search and filters to narrow the options in "Problems to use" below.
problem_search.search_placeholder: Search by name / ID / description / tags

event_create.title: Create new Event
event_create.description: Specify team count and problem set to create an Event. Admins and operators can copy each teamLoginKey from Event details.
event_create.accounts_loading_body: Please wait a few seconds for options to appear.
event_create.no_verified_body: Before creating an Event, add AWS Accounts on the Competitor Accounts page and verify the connection. Accounts that have not been verified cannot be deployed to. After verifying in another tab, click Reload to refresh.
event_create.teams_description: Choose each team's deploy destination for every selected problem target. AWS uses a verified account; non-AWS targets use a team credential slug registered under Competitor Accounts. A team's internal ID cannot be changed after deploy.
event_create.teams_empty: Set team count to at least 1.
event_create.no_verified_helper: No verified accounts available. Add one first.
event_create.duplicate_slug_error: Duplicate internal ID detected. Each team must have a unique value.
event_create.use_problems_description: Multiple selection allowed. Order does not matter.
event_create.capacity_warning_header: Deployment will be refused for this configuration
event_create.deploy_modal_alert_body: Until per-team problem deploy runs, participants cannot access the problems. "Deploy now" runs bulk deploy across all teams × problems. "Later" lets you trigger it from the EventDetail Deploy button.
event_create.deploy_modal_alert_body_non_aws: Bulk deploy currently supports AWS events only. For this event, deploy each team's problem from the Deployments page (New deployment), which uses the provider adapter with the team credential slug bound here.
event_create.login_keys_body: This is the only time plaintext teamLoginKeys are shown. Store and distribute them securely before leaving this dialog.
event_create.login_keys_empty: No team login keys were returned.
event_create.mixed_provider_error: AWS and non-AWS providers cannot be mixed in one event yet. For v1, create separate events per provider.

lite_drill.checkpoint_body: Paste this code into the "Deploy your own TenkaCloud Lite" drill in the landing demo portal to score.

deployments.description: Deploy jobs launched by your tenant. Click a row for details.

event_detail.modal_redeploy_body: This force-redeploys the {count} already-deployed problem(s). Each team's stack is recreated, which may affect work in progress. Continue?
event_detail.phase_description: Where this event sits in the 5-step lifecycle
event_detail.rescue_body: If a stack on a competitor account is stuck in ROLLBACK_COMPLETE etc., the delete does not proceed and the Event stays in TEARDOWN. If nothing moves for 5+ minutes, either ask the competitor to manually delete the stack in the CloudFormation console, or force the Event to ARCHIVED (its deployments are treated as deleted / failed and removed from the Event view). Stacks on the competitor account still need manual deletion by the competitor.
event_detail.bulk_result_body: Accepted: {enqueued} / skipped: {skipped} (actual deploy / delete is run asynchronously by the State Machine. Reload in a few minutes.)
event_detail.deploy_progress_in_flight_description: Deploy is run asynchronously by the State Machine. It takes several minutes.
event_detail.deploy_progress_failed_description: Failed deployments can be retried individually with the "Retry failed" button.
event_detail.deploy_progress_complete_description: All deploys completed. Ready to start the competition.
event_detail.scoring_locked_body: All scoring paths (flag submission / HealthCheck uptime) are stopped. Leaderboard / score events can still be viewed.
event_detail.schedule_description: Setting a start time triggers HealthCheck probing / scoring. Setting an end time closes the scoring gate without changing status.
event_detail.ends_at_unset: Not set (scoring continues until manual "End Event")
event_detail.teardown_at_unset: Not set (no automatic teardown — delete manually)
event_detail.modal_teardown_schedule_body: When the specified time passes, the event's stacks are torn down automatically to stop billing. Set it to or after the end time. The local browser time you enter is converted to UTC (minute precision).
event_detail.error_teardown_past: Cannot specify a past datetime. To tear down now, use "Delete Event".
event_detail.error_teardown_before_ends: Teardown time must be at or after the end time.
event_detail.error_teardown_required: Both teardown date and time are required
event_detail.deploy_at_unset: Not set (no automatic deploy — use "Deploy now")
event_detail.deploy_at_after_deploy_hint: Already deployed (scheduling applies only before the first deploy)
event_detail.modal_deploy_schedule_body: When the specified time passes, the DRAFT event's stacks are deployed automatically for every team × problem. Set it to or before the end time. The local browser time you enter is converted to UTC (minute precision).
event_detail.error_deploy_past: Cannot specify a past datetime. To deploy now, use "Deploy".
event_detail.error_deploy_after_ends: Deploy time must be at or before the end time.
event_detail.error_deploy_required: Both deploy date and time are required
event_detail.freeze_label: Scoreboard freeze minutes (hide ranking from N min before end; 0 to disable)
event_detail.notifications_description: Send an announcement to all teams' Participant Portals. Shown on the Portal's Notifications page; unread count appears as a red badge.
event_detail.notifications_hint: Example timing: "5 minutes until start", "Battle attack detections increased", "Typo in a problem file" etc. Content is delivered to all competitors simultaneously (per-team sending is not supported).
event_detail.notifications_draft_disabled: Cannot send notifications right after Event creation (DRAFT). Enabled after Deploy.
event_detail.notifications_teardown_disabled_teardown: Cannot send notifications for an Event in teardown.
event_detail.notifications_teardown_disabled_archived: Cannot send notifications for an archived Event.
event_detail.problemset_description: Problems used in this Event and their deploy target (account / region)
event_detail.problemset_empty: Not configured — will be addable in Event edit (Phase 2c+)
event_detail.participants_step_1: Open the Teams tab and copy the teamLoginKey for each team
event_detail.participants_step_2: Share the Portal URL above and one key with its corresponding team
event_detail.participants_step_3: Click Deploy to start all teams' problem environments (start the competition when Status becomes READY)
event_detail.participants_step_4: After the competition, click Delete to tear down all environments at once
event_detail.teams_description: Admins and operators can copy each current teamLoginKey here. Regenerate legacy keys that are unavailable.
event_detail.rotate_key_warning_header: The current key will stop working immediately
event_detail.rotate_key_warning_body: Every active deployment for this team will move to a new key. Redistribute the replacement key after rotation.
event_detail.rotate_key_success_body: The new key is saved and remains available to admins and operators in Event details.
event_detail.modal_end_event_body: Transition the Event to ENDED and stop HealthCheck scoring (deployments preserved). Use this when moving to the award phase.
event_detail.modal_force_archive_body: Transition the Event to ARCHIVED and remove it from the default list view.
event_detail.modal_force_archive_alert_header: Physical stack still needs manual deletion by the competitor
event_detail.modal_force_archive_alert_body: This only changes the Event's status to ARCHIVED. Any CloudFormation stack stuck in ROLLBACK_COMPLETE etc. on the competitor account must be manually deleted by the competitor from the CloudFormation console.
event_detail.modal_teardown_header: Delete all deployments for this Event?
event_detail.modal_teardown_body: All deployments under this Event will be moved to DELETING and a CloudFormation stack delete will be issued on competitor accounts. Cannot be undone.
event_detail.error_endsat_past: Cannot specify a past datetime. To end now, use the "End Event" button.
event_detail.error_endsat_before_start: End time must be after start time.
event_detail.error_date_time_required: Both date and time are required
event_detail.error_startsat_past: Cannot specify a past datetime. To start now, use the "Start now" button.
event_detail.error_endsat_required: Both end date and time are required
event_detail.error_freeze_required: Enter freeze minutes (0 disables; 1–180 valid range)
event_detail.error_freeze_range: Freeze minutes must be an integer between 0 and 180
event_detail.error_lock_status: Scoring can be locked only when the Event is READY or ENDED. Please check the current status.
event_detail.error_unlock_status: Unlocking scoring is allowed only when the Event is READY or ENDED.
event_detail.error_end_status_with_current: Event can be ended only when status is READY (current: {current})
event_detail.error_end_status: Event can be ended only when status is READY
event_detail.participants_no_url_body: The participant portal URL is not configured, so it cannot be shown. Please check the configuration with an administrator.
event_detail.modal_end_event_extra: Cannot return to READY from ENDED. To resume, create a new Event.
event_detail.modal_teardown_extra: Rows already in DELETING / DELETED are idempotently skipped. "Retry only failed rows" is planned for Phase 3+.
event_detail.modal_schedule_body: When the specified time passes, HealthCheck starts scoring. The local browser time you enter is converted to UTC and saved (minute precision).
event_detail.modal_endsat_body: When the specified time passes, scoring stops automatically. Unlike "End Event" (which stops immediately), the status stays READY and no manual action is needed. The local browser time you enter is converted to UTC (minute precision).
event_detail.notification_sent_body: Will appear on the competitors' Participant Portal /notifications within 60 seconds.
event_detail.operations_intro: This tab is not for normal workflow. It collects recovery (rescue) and deploy-progress inspection. Deploy / teardown now live on the Schedule tab. Use the other tabs for day-to-day work.
event_detail.operations_deploy_progress_empty: No deploy has been kicked off yet. Press "Deploy now" on the Schedule tab to start.
event_detail.phase_banner_setup_body: Provision teams, problems and the schedule before going live.
event_detail.phase_banner_live_body: Scoring is active. Avoid destructive actions until you press End Event.
event_detail.phase_banner_teardown_body: Scoring is stopped. You can safely delete remaining deployments.
event_detail.modal_teardown_blast_radius_body: {teamCount} team(s) × {problemCount} problem(s) — all CloudFormation stacks will be deleted on the competitor accounts. Cannot be undone.
event_detail.modal_teardown_confirm_input_description: Destructive action gate — the button activates only when you type DELETE.

send_notification.body_placeholder: Scoring that was paused for maintenance has resumed. Please continue the competition.

callback.missing_code: Authorization code not found in the redirect URL.

team_score_events_panel.description: Cumulative score trend across all {count} teams (click legend to toggle series)
team_score_events_panel.empty: No score events yet. Recorded by flag submissions, Battle uptime, hint reveals, etc.
team_score_events_panel.aria_label: Cumulative score trend across all teams

team_ranking_panel.description: Sorted by cumulative score (descending). Ties are broken by the earlier last update.

event_report.title: Event Report
event_report.cover_note_label: Cover note (editable; persists for this session)
event_report.cover_note_placeholder: Add an introductory paragraph for the customer.
event_report.cover_note_default: Thank you for hosting your competition on TenkaCloud. This report summarizes the final results and operational outcome of the event.
event_report.scoreboard_empty: No score events recorded for this event.
event_report.problems_empty: No problems configured for this event.
event_report.disruptions_description: Timeline of wrong flag submissions and other negative-point events recorded during the competition.
event_report.footer_generated_by: Generated by TenkaCloud Application Admin Console
event_report.footer_branding: TenkaCloud — Multi-tenant cloud competition platform on AWS

deployment_detail.phase_building_description: Preparing the CloudFormation stack to deploy the problem to the competitor account.
deployment_detail.phase_building_link: Open CloudFormation logs in AWS Console
deployment_detail.phase_building_url_unavailable: CloudFormation console URL is not yet available.
deployment_detail.stack_not_yet_created: The CloudFormation stack has not been created yet. Once deployment starts, its events and resources will appear here.
deployment_detail.stuck_elapsed: {minutes} minute(s) elapsed since the most recent CloudFormation event.
deployment_detail.resources_empty: No resources have been created yet.
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_description: Recovery runbook for a failed deployment — follow in order.
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_step_retry: Press Reload above, then go back to the Event and click Retry failed. Transient AWS errors usually clear on retry.
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_step_verify_pre: If retry keeps failing, re-verify the competitor AWS account on the
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_step_verify_post: — the ExternalId or IAM role may have rotated.
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_step_contact_pre: If verification passes but deploy still fails, the issue is likely in the problem template itself.
deployment_detail.failure_guidance_step_contact_link: Open an issue on the problem repository
deployment_detail.composite_targets_description: Per-target deployment status for this composite problem.
deployment_detail.composite_targets_empty: This composite deployment has no targets yet.
deployment_detail.provenance_description: This problem was delivered by an installed problem pack, pinned to the event's catalog snapshot.

problem_detail.not_found_body: Problem ID ({problemId}) is not in the catalog.
problem_detail.endpoints_intro: On deploy completion, the ports below brought up in the competitor account are exposed as shareable URLs.
problem_detail.endpoints_access_header: Access is gated by a per-team login key
problem_detail.endpoints_access_body_pre: Each endpoint is gated by a
problem_detail.endpoints_access_body_post: issued at deploy time. Per-individual accounts are not created, so operators are not responsible for invitations / resets / deletions of individual user accounts.
problem_detail.deployments_description: In-progress and past deploy jobs for this problem.
problem_detail.deployments_empty: No deploy history for this problem yet.

competitor_accounts.title: Competitor Accounts
competitor_accounts.description: Competitor AWS accounts linked to this tenant. Only verified accounts can be deployed to. To update the ExternalId, delete the account and add it again.
competitor_accounts.bootstrap_url_missing_header: Stack template URL is not configured
competitor_accounts.bootstrap_url_missing_body: The stack template URL is not configured, so the Launch Stack link is unavailable. Please check the configuration with an administrator.
competitor_accounts.table_empty: No Competitor Accounts registered yet. Click "Add account" to start.
competitor_accounts.delete_modal_body_1: Remove AWS Account {accountId} from the tenant?
competitor_accounts.delete_modal_body_2: If this is the last account in the tenant, its stored ExternalId is deleted too. To update the ExternalId, add an account again after deleting; a new ExternalId is issued.
competitor_accounts.add_modal_role_description: IAM Role name created during competitor-side setup. The default `TenkaCloud-{tenantId}-deploy-Role` is unique per environment, so the same AWS account can connect to multiple environments (e.g. separate events) at once.
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_header: Information to share with the competitor
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_warning_header: ExternalId can only be viewed on this screen
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_warning_body: ExternalId is stored encrypted and cannot be shown again once this screen is closed. Copy the value to share with the competitor now.
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_launch_hint: Opens the CloudFormation create-stack screen with all 3 parameters pre-filled.
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_copy_all: Copy all (3 values + instructions + Launch Stack URL)
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_step_1: Open Launch Stack and create the bootstrap stack
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_step_2: After deploy completes, click "Verify" on this screen to confirm the connection
competitor_accounts.secret_modal_manual_hint: You can also pass the 3 values as Parameters to CloudFormation create-stack.

team_cloud_credentials.title: Team cloud credentials (non-AWS clouds)
team_cloud_credentials.description: Before deploying non-AWS problems (Sakura / Azure / GCP), register each team's cloud credential. Credentials are stored encrypted and are never shown in listings. To update a key, register the same team again.
team_cloud_credentials.team_description: The slug derived from the team name at deploy time (lowercase, digits, hyphens).
team_cloud_credentials.team_invalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
team_cloud_credentials.credential_description: Provider-specific JSON. Sakura: {accessToken, accessTokenSecret} / Azure: {azureTenantId, clientId, clientSecret, subscriptionId, resourceGroup} / GCP: {wifAudience, serviceAccountEmail, projectId, location, artifactBucket}.
team_cloud_credentials.setup_help_enable: This panel appears only when features.nonAwsRuntime is enabled (runtime-config.json).
team_cloud_credentials.setup_help_sakura: Sakura: issue an API key in the control panel, then enter {accessToken, accessTokenSecret}.
team_cloud_credentials.setup_help_azure: Azure: run az ad sp create-for-rbac to create an Entra app + RBAC, then enter {azureTenantId, clientId, clientSecret, subscriptionId, resourceGroup}.
team_cloud_credentials.setup_help_gcp: GCP: use gcloud to create a Workload Identity pool + service account, then enter {wifAudience, serviceAccountEmail, projectId, location, artifactBucket} (keyless). artifactBucket is your own GCS bucket for the Terraform blueprint zip — grant the service account write access to it.
team_cloud_credentials.setup_help_ssm_note: Submitted credentials are stored encrypted via the API (SSM SecureString); operators never edit SSM directly.
team_cloud_credentials.invalid_json: The credential JSON is invalid. Please enter valid JSON.
team_cloud_credentials.registered: Registered (deploys will authenticate with this credential).

tenant_users.title: Users
tenant_users.description: Tenant console users and roles. Invitations are limited to this tenant.
tenant_users.readonly_body: Your account can view users, but only TenantAdmin can invite, remove, or change roles.
tenant_users.empty_body: Invite TenantAdmin, TenantOperator, or TenantViewer accounts for this tenant.

identity_providers.title: Identity providers
identity_providers.description: SAML identity providers connected to this tenant's sign-in. The sign-in screen shows a picker for all configured providers.
identity_providers.feature_disabled_body: Per-tenant SAML SSO is not enabled for this environment yet. Contact your administrator to turn it on.
identity_providers.silo_only_description: Per-tenant SAML SSO is a PLATINUM (silo) plan feature.
identity_providers.silo_only_header: Per-tenant SAML SSO requires the silo plan
identity_providers.silo_only_body: This tenant runs on a shared sign-in pool. Per-tenant identity-provider management is available only on the PLATINUM (silo) plan — please contact your account manager.
identity_providers.not_wired_body: This feature is not configured for your environment. Please contact an administrator.
identity_providers.empty_body: Tenant sign-in falls back to email + password. Click Add SAML IdP to connect Entra ID or another SAML provider.
identity_providers.info_alert: The same email signed in through two different providers is treated as two separate identities. Plan your group-to-role mapping accordingly.

create_idp.idp_id_description: Provider name. 3–32 characters: letters, digits, _ or -.
create_idp.provider_description: Choose a provider to show concise SAML setup steps.
create_idp.acs_url_description: Enter this as the assertion consumer service, reply, or single sign-on URL.
create_idp.sp_entity_description: Set this value as-is as the IdP's Audience / Entity ID / Identifier.
create_idp.sp_entity_description_placeholder: Replace <userPoolId> with your User Pool ID from the AWS Cognito console, then set it as the IdP's Audience / Entity ID.
create_idp.email_attr_map_description: Map the IdP email claim to this SAML attribute. It follows the Email attribute (SAML) field above.
create_idp.metadata_file_description: Upload the IdP metadata as an .xml file.
create_idp.metadata_xml_description: Paste the full IdP metadata XML.
create_idp.empty_metadata_error: The selected metadata XML file is empty.
create_idp.read_metadata_error: Could not read the selected metadata XML file. Try another file or paste the XML below.
create_idp.guide_entra_step_1: In Microsoft Entra ID, open Enterprise applications -> New application -> Single sign-on -> SAML.
create_idp.guide_entra_step_2: Set Reply URL to the ACS URL and Identifier to the SP Entity ID below.
create_idp.guide_entra_step_3: Download Federation Metadata XML, then upload it below.
create_idp.guide_google_step_1: In Google Workspace, open Admin console -> Apps -> Web and mobile apps -> Add custom SAML app.
create_idp.guide_google_step_2: Enter the ACS URL and Entity ID below.
create_idp.guide_google_step_3: Download the IdP metadata, then upload it below.
create_idp.guide_generic_step_1: Give the IdP administrator the ACS URL, SP Entity ID, and email attribute below.
create_idp.guide_generic_step_2: Configure the IdP metadata XML, then upload it below.

disruptions.description: Fire a declared disruption at teams during the Battle. Each problem declares its own disruptions; the platform injects the fault into the team's deployed stack and auto-reverts it.
disruptions.catalog_empty: No disruptions are declared for this event's problems.
disruptions.audit_empty: No disruptions have been fired yet.
disruptions.random_label: Pick the pool of teams (a random subset is hit)
disruptions.random_description: The platform hits a random subset sized to your selection.
disruptions.timing_description: Inject immediately, schedule it after N minutes, or repeat it on an interval.
disruptions.after_minutes_description: 1–1440 minutes. The injection runs once this many minutes have elapsed.
disruptions.after_minutes_error: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1440.
disruptions.recurring_description: Left = minutes between injections (1–1440); right = max number of fires (1–60). Auto-stops once the cap is reached (always ends).
disruptions.recurring_error: Interval must be 1–1440 and max fires 1–60 (whole numbers).
disruptions.recurring_flash: Set "{name}" to fire every {interval} min, up to {count} times.
disruptions.team_status_description: Where each team stands right now — use it to time disruptions.

gate.description: Advanced event rule: lock selected problems until a gate challenge is completed, with per-team overrides and one-time completion bonuses (handicaps).
gate.flags_error_header: Failed to load tenant feature flags
gate.feature_toggle_label: Enable the Progression Gate feature for this tenant (challengePrerequisiteGate — TenantAdmin only)
gate.error_toggle_forbidden: Changing tenant feature flags requires the TenantAdmin role.
gate.disabled_alert_body: The per-tenant runtime flag challengePrerequisiteGate is OFF, so gate settings cannot be edited and no problem is locked. Turn the toggle above ON (TenantAdmin only) to edit. Any stored configuration is shown read-only below.
gate.unlock_targets_label: Unlock targets (locked until the gate is completed)
gate.policy_required: required — locked until the gate is completed
gate.policy_off: off — bypass the gate (all problems from the start)
gate.overrides_description: Override the default policy per team, and optionally grant a one-time completion bonus (handicap). Teams left on "inherit" follow the default policy.
gate.modal_remove_body: All unlock targets become available to every team from the next read. No deployment is deleted. Removal is idempotent and allowed even while the feature flag is OFF.
gate.error_feature_disabled: The tenant feature flag (challengePrerequisiteGate) is OFF, so the gate settings were rejected. Enable the feature first.
gate.error_reason_gate_problem_not_in_event: The gate challenge is not part of this event's problem set.
gate.error_reason_unlock_target_not_in_event: An unlock target is not part of this event's problem set.
gate.error_reason_unknown_override_team: A team override references a team that does not exist in this event.
gate.error_reason_event_archived: Gate settings cannot be changed on an archived event.
gate.error_no_targets: Choose at least one unlock target.
gate.error_bonus_range: Completion bonus must be an integer between 0 and 100000.

capacity.description: Event-hot table consumption over the last {windowMinutes} minutes. The runbook ceiling is {ceiling} RCU/WCU.
capacity.load_failed: Failed to load capacity data. Try again or contact an operator if the problem continues.
capacity.runbook_hint: Scale capacity up or down (SSM runbook)
capacity.runbook_doc_pointer: See docs/operations/dynamodb-event-capacity.md for sizing guidance. Scale back to 1/1 with the same runbook after the event.
capacity.forbidden: Capacity monitoring is visible to TenantAdmin only.
capacity.unconfigured: The capacity monitoring backend is not wired yet (deploy chain update required).
capacity.demo_unsupported: Demo mode does not simulate capacity monitoring.
capacity.scale_constraint: 1-{ceiling}. The billed total is the value x (1 + GSI count).
capacity.scale_warning: DynamoDB limits how many times a table can be scaled down per day. UpdateTable is asynchronous, so the change takes time to apply (watch the 30-second auto refresh).
capacity.scale_accepted: Change accepted (execution {executionId}). It may take a few minutes to apply.
